ModMetaData.name: Cultist — 密教模拟器扩展
ModMetaData.author: linyuye
ModMetaData.description:
将《密教模拟器》的九大相性、漫宿入梦地图、密教结社、防剿局清剿与大小胜飞升线融入环世界 1.7（需 Ideology DLC）。 A RimWorld 1.7 (Ideology) expansion inspired by Cultist Simulator: nine Aspects, interactive Mansus dream map, secret societies, Suppression Bureau raids, and Long / Apostle victories.
• 九大相性教团与 1–7 阶秘传书籍、古语研读与赞助人委托 Nine Aspect societies, Tier 1–7 Lore books, ancient languages, and patron commissions. • 漫宿交互入梦地图（林地至孔雀门）与三选一翻牌探索 Interactive Mansus dream map (Wood to Peacock Door) with 3-card draw exploration. • 9 大相性服饰与 7 把差异化武器（2 把近战 + 5 把远程秘传武器） Nine Aspect apparel sets and 7 differentiated weapons (2 melee + 5 ranged occult weapons). • 高阶门徒专属技能与随机词条、5 种总部圣所特质、长生者小胜 & 使徒大胜结局 Exalted disciple abilities & random traits, 5 HQ sanctuary traits, Long Minor & Apostle Major Victories.
作者的话：本 Mod 是我借助 Gemini 与 ChatGPT 用一晚上加一白天制作出来的，难免存在不足；因没有专职美术，美术素材来自原游戏《密教模拟器》与 AIGC 生图工具，对其他 Mod 的兼容也难以一一保证。本项目按 MIT 协议开源，欢迎游玩并反馈 Bug，我会不时更新，也欢迎到 GitHub 提 Issue 与 PR！ Author's Note: Built in a single night and day with Gemini and ChatGPT, so rough edges and mod-compatibility quirks may exist. Visual assets come from Cultist Simulator and AIGC tools. Open-sourced under the MIT License—feedback, bug reports, issues, and PRs on GitHub are warmly welcome!
GitHub: https://github.com/linyuye/RimWorld-Cultist
